item.author: @ReadwiseReader
item.description:
New in Reader: Quick Lookup

Long-press any word, name, or term and get its meaning instantly.

Reader synthesizes the author's own definition of terms, pulled from their usage in the document.

One more tap saves the definition, so what you look up actually stays with you.

item.title: Say an author coins a term and uses it across several chapters. Lookup pulls it into one clear
item.author: @ReadwiseReader
item.description:
Say an author coins a term and uses it across several chapters.

Lookup pulls it into one clear definition, in their words, with the passages it draws from.

No more flipping back 200 pages!
